questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-5)4 - (-1)2=-18\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: What is the largest possible rank of a 5×5 matrix?
questions.explanation: Rank cannot exceed the number of rows or the number of columns, so the maximum is min(5, 5) = 5.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}4&0\\0&-2\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,2) entry of \(A^{5}\).

questions.prompt: For \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1&5&-1\\0&1&4\\4&2&-2\end{bmatrix}\), find the (3,1) entry of \(\operatorname{adj}A\).

multiplying a row by a non-zero number

questions.explanation: The matrix is lower triangular, so the determinant is the product of the diagonal entries: 4 · 1 · 3 = 12.

questions.prompt: \(A^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}-3&-5\\2&3\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}-10&-3\\3&1\end{bmatrix}\). Find the (1,2) entry of \((AB)^{-1}\).
questions.explanation: \((AB)^{-1}=B^{-1}A^{-1}\) (reverse order). Multiplying, the (1,2) entry is 41; the other order \(A^{-1}B^{-1}\) would give 4.

questions.prompt: For the system \(\left\{\begin{aligned}2x + 3y &= 6\\-x + z &= 2\\x + z &= 2\end{aligned}\right.\), find the determinant \(D\) of the coefficient matrix.
questions.explanation: \(D=\begin{vmatrix}2&3&0\\-1&0&1\\1&0&1\end{vmatrix}\) = 6.

questions.prompt: Which name describes the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}0&1&-2\\-1&0&-4\\2&4&0\end{bmatrix}\)?
questions.explanation: This is a skew-symmetric matrix because \(a_{ij}\) = -\(a_{ji}\), so the diagonal is 0.

questions.prompt: The point (5, -1) is translated by \((2,-3)\) (add 2 to x and -3 to y). Find the new x-coordinate.
questions.explanation: New x = old x + shift = 5 + 2 = 7.

questions.prompt: A two-letter word (A=1,…,Z=26) was coded as \(\begin{bmatrix}41&20\end{bmatrix}\) using a key whose inverse is \(K^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}1&-1\\-2&3\end{bmatrix}\). What is letter 2 of the word?
questions.explanation: Decode by post-multiplying by the inverse key: \(\begin{bmatrix}41&20\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1&-1\\-2&3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1&19\end{bmatrix}\), so the numbers are 1 and 19, i.e. AS. Letter 2 is S.

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (3, 5), (3, 1), (4, 0) using a determinant.
questions.explanation: Area = ½|\(\begin{vmatrix}3&5&1\\3&1&1\\4&0&1\end{vmatrix}\)| = ½|4| = \(2\) square units.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1&-1&-3\\-8&-6&8\\9&7&-4\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}5&3&4\\-8&-6&2\\-3&3&0\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,2) entry of \(A+B\).
questions.explanation: Add/subtract corresponding entries: (-6) + (-6) = -12.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}-6&3\\1&1\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-6)1 - 31=-9\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: For \(A=\begin{bmatrix}3&2&6\\-5&7&0\\5&-3&0\end{bmatrix}\), find the minor \(M_{31}\).
questions.explanation: Delete row 3 and column 1: \(M_{31}=\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\) = -42.

questions.prompt: Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&-1\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}2&-4\\-3&3\end{bmatrix}\). Find the (2,2) entry of \(AB\).
questions.explanation: Row 2 of A times column 2 of B: 0((-4)) + (-1)(3) = -3.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}-4&-2\\-1&-6\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-4)(-6) - (-2)(-1)=22\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: Apply \(R_{2}\to R_{2}+4R_{1}\) to \(A=\begin{bmatrix}2&-6\\-6&-4\end{bmatrix}\). What is the new entry in row 2, column 1?

questions.explanation: The sum of all entries is 8, and each friendship is counted twice, so there are 4 pairs.

questions.prompt: Find the rank of \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-1&3&-2\\1&-3&2\\-3&9&-6\end{bmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: Reduce to echelon form with row operations; the number of non-zero rows left is the rank. Here the rank is 1.

questions.prompt: The identity matrix \(I\) is a scalar matrix whose diagonal entries are:
questions.explanation: All diagonal entries of \(I\) are 1 and all other entries are 0.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}4&3\\8&6\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=46 - 38=0\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is singular.

questions.prompt: After row operations the augmented matrix of a system in x, y, z is \(\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1&-2&-1&6\\0&1&-2&-2\\0&0&1&-4\end{array}\right]\). How many solutions does the system have?
questions.explanation: rank A = 3 and rank [A:B] = 3, with n = 3 unknowns. Ranks equal and equal to n: exactly one solution.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}3&-3&7\\0&6&-5\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}1&3&7\\-6&-3&0\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,3) entry of \(-2A+2B\).
questions.explanation: Multiply each matrix by its scalar, then add: (-2)((-5)) + 2(0) = 10.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}-1&-1\\-6&-5\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-1)(-5) - (-1)(-6)=-1\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: Find k so that \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-2&k\\-2k+12&4\end{bmatrix}\) is symmetric (\(a_{12}=a_{21}\)).
For what value of k is \(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-2&k\end{vmatrix}\) singular (determinant 0)?
questions.explanation: \(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-2&k\end{vmatrix}=2k - (-2)\); setting it to 0 gives \(2k=-2\), so k = -1.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-4&6\\-1&6\\-2&-4\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}1&-1\\-2&-3\\-3&-5\end{bmatrix}\), find the (1,2) entry of \(-2A+4B\).
questions.explanation: Multiply each matrix by its scalar, then add: (-2)(6) + 4((-1)) = -16.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-2&-1\\2&0\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,1) entry of \(A^{2}\).
questions.explanation: \(A^{2}=AA\); row 2 times column 1: 2((-2)) + 0(2) = -4. (It is not just squaring each entry.)

questions.prompt: Find the rank of \(A=\begin{bmatrix}3&5\\0&3\end{bmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: Reduce to echelon form with row operations; the number of non-zero rows left is the rank. Here the rank is 2.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-5&2\\-1&-1\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}-1&5\\0&-5\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,1) entry of \(2A-B\).
questions.explanation: Multiply each matrix by its scalar, then add: 2((-1)) + (-1)(0) = -2.

questions.prompt: The transpose \(A^{T}\) of a matrix is obtained by:
questions.explanation: The rows of A become the columns of \(A^{T}\).

options: changing the sign of every entry

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\9&-5\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}3&-8\\4&-7\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,2) entry of \(A+B\).
questions.explanation: Add/subtract corresponding entries: (-5) + (-7) = -12.

questions.prompt: Without expanding, find the value of \(\begin{vmatrix}5&4&2\\-5&3&-1\\0&7&1\end{vmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: The determinant is 0 because the matrix has R3 = R1 + R2, so the rows are dependent.

questions.prompt: If \(\begin{bmatrix}-2x-1&-3\\4&4y+2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-1&-3\\4&14\end{bmatrix}\), find \(x\).
questions.explanation: Equal matrices have equal corresponding entries: \(-2x-1=-1\) gives x = 0; \(4y+2=14\) gives y = 3. So x = 0.

questions.prompt: If A is a 2×2 matrix with \(|A|=5\), find \(|A^{-1}|\).

questions.explanation: rank A = 3 and rank [A:B] = 3, with n = 3 unknowns. Ranks equal and equal to n: exactly one solution.

questions.prompt: Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4&-4\\-4&-1&-1\\2&-2&4\end{vmatrix}\).

questions.prompt: For what value of k is \(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-4&k\end{vmatrix}\) singular (determinant 0)?
questions.explanation: \(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-4&k\end{vmatrix}=-2k - (-8)\); setting it to 0 gives \(-2k=-8\), so k = 4.

questions.prompt: Find the trace of \(A=\begin{bmatrix}8&9&4\\-8&4&-3\\6&-3&3\end{bmatrix}\) (the sum of the main-diagonal entries).
If \(A\) has order 3 × 2 and \(B\) has order 2 × 4, what is the order of \(AB\)?
questions.explanation: AB is defined because the columns of A (2) equal the rows of B (2); the order is rows of A × columns of B = 3 × 4.

questions.prompt: The cofactor \(C_{ij}\) is related to the minor by:
questions.explanation: The cofactor is the minor with the place-sign \((-1)^{i+j}\).

questions.prompt: A square matrix that has an inverse has:
questions.explanation: The inverse of a matrix, when it exists, is unique.

questions.prompt: Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\).
If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}7&-2&0\\-1&7&5\\1&5&2\end{bmatrix}\), find the entry in row 1, column 2 of \(A^{T}\).
questions.explanation: The (i, j) entry of \(A^{T}\) is the (j, i) entry of A, so it is \(a_{21}\) = -1.

questions.prompt: Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-3&3&-4\\0&2&2\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&3\\-3&-3&5\\2&0&-2\end{bmatrix}\). Find the (2,3) entry of \(AB\).
questions.explanation: Row 2 of A times column 3 of B: 0(3) + 2(5) + 2((-2)) = 6.

questions.prompt: The points (1, 3), (5, 3) and (0, k) are collinear. Find k.
questions.explanation: Collinear points give a zero determinant \(\begin{vmatrix}1&3&1\\5&3&1\\0&k&1\end{vmatrix}\) = 0, which expands to \(4 k - 12=0\). So k = 3.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}8&-9\\-7&8\\-4&-6\\1&-7\end{bmatrix}\), find the entry in row 2, column 2 of \(A^{T}\).
questions.explanation: The (i, j) entry of \(A^{T}\) is the (j, i) entry of A, so it is \(a_{22}\) = 8.

questions.prompt: Apply \(R_{2}\to R_{2}+R_{1}\) to \(A=\begin{bmatrix}2&1&2\\2&2&-2\\-2&4&4\end{bmatrix}\). What is the new entry in row 2, column 3?

questions.prompt: Square matrices A and B of the same order have \(|A|=4\) and \(|B|=2\). Find \(|ABA|\).
Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}3&1&-4\\-2&-2&0\\-3&-4&2\end{vmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: Positive terms (aei + bfg + cdh) = -44; negative terms (ceg + afh + bdi) = -28. So the value is -44 - (-28) = -16.

questions.prompt: For \(A=\begin{bmatrix}5&7&7\\2&1&5\\-3&-4&-3\end{bmatrix}\), find the cofactor \(C_{33}\).
Cramer's rule can be used for a square system only when:
questions.explanation: The formulas \(x=D_{x}/D\) etc. divide by \(D\).

questions.prompt: Find k so that \(A=\begin{bmatrix}0&-3k-1\\4&0\end{bmatrix}\) is skew-symmetric (\(a_{12}=-a_{21}\)).
questions.explanation: Skew-symmetric needs \(a_{12}\) = -\(a_{21}\), so \(-3k-1=-4\), i.e. \(-3k=-3\), giving k = 1.

questions.prompt: Find the (2,1) entry of \(A^{-1}\) for \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1&-2\\-1&3\end{bmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: \(|A|=1\) and \(\operatorname{adj}A=\begin{bmatrix}3&2\\1&1\end{bmatrix}\), so \(A^{-1}=\frac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj}A\) has (2,1) entry \(1\).

questions.prompt: State the order of the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}8&2&-6\end{bmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: It has 1 row(s) and 3 column(s), so its order is 1 × 3 (rows first, then columns).

questions.prompt: Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-8&2\end{vmatrix}\).
Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\).
Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2&3\\3&-1&0\\4&3&-1\end{vmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: Positive terms (aei + bfg + cdh) = 31; negative terms (ceg + afh + bdi) = -6. So the value is 31 - (-6) = 37.

questions.prompt: Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-2&1\\-3&-4\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}3&-1\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}\). Find the trace of \(AB\).
questions.explanation: \(AB=\begin{bmatrix}-7&4\\-5&-5\end{bmatrix}\), so the trace is -7 + (-5) = -12.

questions.prompt: A 3×3 matrix has determinant -1. Its determinant after the row operations R1 → R1 - R2; then R2 → -2R2; then R3 → 4R3 (in this order) is:
questions.explanation: Track each operation: R1 → R1 - R2: no change; R2 → -2R2: multiplies the determinant by -2; R3 → 4R3: multiplies the determinant by 4. Result: 8.

questions.prompt: Apply \(R_{1}\to R_{1}-4R_{2}\) to \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-5&4&1\\7&5&0\\4&5&1\end{bmatrix}\). What is the new entry in row 1, column 3?
questions.explanation: New entry = 1 - 4(0) = 1.

questions.prompt: The point (-4, -6) is translated by \((-2,-4)\) (add -2 to x and -4 to y). Find the new x-coordinate.
questions.explanation: New x = old x + shift = (-4) + (-2) = -6.

questions.prompt: Which name describes the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}6&-2\\-2&-4\end{bmatrix}\)?
questions.explanation: This is a symmetric matrix because it equals its transpose, \(a_{ij}\) = \(a_{ji}\).

questions.prompt: Square matrices A and B of the same order have \(|A|=-5\) and \(|B|=-1\). Find \(|ABA|\).
For the system \(\left\{\begin{aligned}2x + 6y &= -32\\-2x - 5y &= 28\end{aligned}\right.\), find the determinant \(D\) of the coefficient matrix.
questions.explanation: \(D=\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\) = 2.

questions.prompt: A two-letter word (A=1,…,Z=26) was coded as \(\begin{bmatrix}24&9\end{bmatrix}\) using a key whose inverse is \(K^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}1&1\\-1&-2\end{bmatrix}\). What is letter 2 of the word?
questions.explanation: Decode by post-multiplying by the inverse key: \(\begin{bmatrix}24&9\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1&1\\-1&-2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}15&6\end{bmatrix}\), so the numbers are 15 and 6, i.e. OF. Letter 2 is F.

questions.prompt: For \(A=\begin{bmatrix}5&-5&7\\-1&6&0\\5&-4&5\end{bmatrix}\), find the cofactor \(C_{13}\).
\(A^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}0&1\\1&-1\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}-1&1\\1&-2\end{bmatrix}\). Find the (2,2) entry of \((AB)^{-1}\).
questions.explanation: \((AB)^{-1}=B^{-1}A^{-1}\) (reverse order). Multiplying, the (2,2) entry is 3; the other order \(A^{-1}B^{-1}\) would give 3.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}3&-2&1\\4&-2&-3\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}5&2&1\\-4&3&-3\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,3) entry of \(4A+4B\).
questions.explanation: Multiply each matrix by its scalar, then add: 4((-3)) + 4((-3)) = -24.

questions.prompt: For what value of k is \(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\3&k\end{vmatrix}\) singular (determinant 0)?
questions.explanation: \(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\3&k\end{vmatrix}=-3k - (-15)\); setting it to 0 gives \(-3k=-15\), so k = 5.

questions.prompt: Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4&1\\0&-4&6\\0&0&-5\end{vmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: The matrix is upper triangular, so the determinant is the product of the diagonal entries: (-2) · (-4) · (-5) = -40.

questions.prompt: If \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-1&0\\0&2\end{bmatrix}\), find the (2,2) entry of \(A^{5}\).
questions.explanation: For a diagonal matrix, \(A^{5}\) has diagonal entries -\(1^{5}\) and \(2^{5}\); the (2,2) entry is \(2^{5}\) = 32.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}-5&4\\-3&3\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-5)3 - 4(-3)=-3\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: Square matrices A and B of the same order have \(|A|=-4\) and \(|B|=4\). Find \(|A^{2}|\).

questions.explanation: \(D=\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\) = 9.

questions.prompt: Using \(A=1,\ B=2,\dots,Z=26\), the word OF is written as a row matrix and multiplied on the right by the key \(K=\begin{bmatrix}3&2\\2&1\end{bmatrix}\). Find entry 2 of the coded row.
questions.explanation: OF → \(\begin{bmatrix}15&6\end{bmatrix}\). Coded row = \(\begin{bmatrix}15&6\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3&2\\2&1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}57&36\end{bmatrix}\); entry 2 is 36.

questions.prompt: Gaussian elimination reduces a system to \(\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1&-2&1&-10\\0&1&3&5\\0&0&1&0\end{array}\right]\). Find x by back-substitution.
questions.explanation: From the last row z = 0. The second row gives y = 5 - 3(0) = 5. The first row gives x = -10 - (-2)(5) - 1(0) = 0.

questions.prompt: Apply \(R_{3}\to R_{3}-4R_{2}\) to \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-4&6&4&7\\-5&3&4&3\\-6&7&-1&-4\end{bmatrix}\). What is the new entry in row 3, column 3?
Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}-6&5\\-6&0\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-6)0 - 5(-6)=30\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: If \(\begin{bmatrix}-x&0\\5&y-4\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\5&-3\end{bmatrix}\), find \(x\).
questions.explanation: Equal matrices have equal corresponding entries: \(-x=1\) gives x = -1; \(y-4=-3\) gives y = 1. So x = -1.

questions.prompt: Find the (2,2) entry of \(A^{-1}\) for \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-2&1&10\\-1&0&5\\-1&0&4\end{bmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: \(|A|=-1\), so \(A^{-1}=\operatorname{adj}A/|A|\) = \(-\operatorname{adj}A\). Its (2,2) entry is -2.

questions.prompt: Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}5&2\\1&5\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B=\begin{bmatrix}0&2\\5&5\end{bmatrix}\). Find the trace of \(AB\).

questions.prompt: If \(A\) has order 4 × 5 and \(B\) has order 5 × 5, what is the order of \(AB\)?
questions.explanation: AB is defined because the columns of A (5) equal the rows of B (5); the order is rows of A × columns of B = 4 × 5.

questions.prompt: Find k so that \(A=\begin{bmatrix}0&-2k-3\\-5&0\end{bmatrix}\) is skew-symmetric (\(a_{12}=-a_{21}\)).
questions.explanation: Skew-symmetric needs \(a_{12}\) = -\(a_{21}\), so \(-2k-3=5\), i.e. \(-2k=8\), giving k = -4.
